Simulated HOURLY-equivalent test count. For Ookla-anchored cells this is Poisson-sampled around an hourly rate derived from the REAL quarterly total (ookla_quarter_test_count / ~2160 hours, scaled by demand), NOT the quarterly total itself repeated per hour (that was a bug — see CHANGELOG). Represents measurement VOLUME, not the outcome — safe as a feature in either target mode.
